# Ha PPY — Tensor Networks

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “HaPPY code holographic”).

claims.name: consequence_show_tripartite_entanglement_happy
claims.statement: As a consequence, we show that tripartite entanglement in the HaPPY code is not holographic.

sources.title: Tripartite entanglement in the HaPPY code is not holographic

claims.name: generalization_pastawskiyoshidaharlowpreskill_happy_holographic_code
claims.statement: A generalization of the Pastawski-Yoshida-Harlow-Preskill (HaPPY) holographic code provides a toy model for bulk gauge fields or linearized gravitons.

sources.title: Living on the Edge: A Toy Model for Holographic Reconstruction of Algebras with Centers

claims.name: paper_generalizes_happy_holographic_code
claims.statement: The paper generalizes the HaPPY holographic code by adding edge degrees of freedom linked by isometries to further HaPPY-code copies, producing a toy model for bulk gauge fields or linearized gravitons. In this model, boundary regions reconstruct bulk algebras with central elements on interior edges of the greedy entanglement wedge, and complementary boundary regions can reconstruct those same central elements as well.

sources.title: Living on the Edge: A Toy Model for Holographic Reconstruction of Algebras with Centers

claims.name: initiate_systematic_study_stabiliser_codes
claims.statement: We initiate a systematic study of stabiliser codes for higher-dimensional holographic geometries, constructing AdS$_4$ analogues of the HaPPY code via cellulations and showing that absolutely maximally entangled codes preserving polytope symmetry cannot exist above two dimensions.

sources.title: Holography, cellulations and error correcting codes

claims.name: using_ghzforbidding_inequality_built_reflected
claims.statement: Using the GHZ-forbidding inequality built from reflected entropy and tripartite multi-entropy, the paper shows that stabilizer states are either violated or saturated, never strictly satisfying the holographic condition. It concludes in particular that the tripartite entanglement structure of the HaPPY code is not holographic.

sources.title: Tripartite entanglement in the HaPPY code is not holographic
